title: PacBio 16S rRNA reads
text:
QIIME2
Only a few reads do not have primer sequences.
Trying two different methods:

run denoise-ccs to perform all primer removal and dada2 steps
remove primers and run denoise-ccs to perform just the dada2 steps

QIIME2 version: 2026.1
Installation






Note




Tried QIIME 2026.4, but it uses scikit-learn v1.7.1 which is incompatible with existing classifiers.

A classifier was built with the new version, but the evaluators are not available in QIIME 2026.4, as on 3rd Jul 2026 - check ncbi_classifier.qmd (note to self).

So using the latest version of QIIME2 with scikit-learn v1.4.2, i.e. 2026.1



$ conda env create --name q2_261 --file https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qiime2/distributions/refs/heads/dev/2026.1/amplicon/released/qiime2-amplicon-ubuntu-latest-conda.yml
Make a manifest file (Table 3)
$ echo -e "sample-id\tabsolute-filepath" > manifest_raw.tsv
$ awk '{ print $1"\t$PWD/raw_reads/"$1".fastq.gz" }' samples_list.txt >> manifest_raw.tsv

Import data into q2 pipeline
$ mkdir q2_raw
(q2_261)$ qiime tools import --type 'SampleData[SequencesWithQuality]' --input-path manifest_raw.tsv --output-path q2_raw/1_import.qza --input-format SingleEndFastqManifestPhred33V2
$ cd q2_raw
(q2_261)$ qiime demux summarize --i-data 1_import.qza --o-visualization 1_import.qzv

Denoise directly
Run DADA2
(q2_261)$ qiime dada2 denoise-ccs --i-demultiplexed-seqs 1_import.qza --p-front AGRGTTYGATYMTGGCTCAG --p-adapter AAGTCGTAACAAGGTARCY --p-min-len 1000 --p-max-len 1600 --p-n-threads 10 --o-table 2_table.qza --o-representative-sequences 2_repseqs.qza --o-denoising-stats 2_stats.qza --o-base-transition-stats 2_bt_stats.qza
# Generate visualization for stats
(q2_261)$ qiime metadata tabulate --m-input-file 2_stats.qza --o-visualization 2_stats.qzv






CautionVery few reads



Only a few reads were retained ranging from 1-74 per sample.
Trying the reverse complement “RGYTACCTTGTTACGACTT” as an argument for --p-adapter. Mentioned here and here


Upon searching for the above sequence, it was found a few bp before the 3’ region and in very less numbers.
$ grep '[GA]G[TC]TACCTTGTTACGACTT' raw_reads/SRR23295634.fastq
# 64 occurrences
Anyways, trying the modification
(q2_261)$ qiime dada2 denoise-ccs --i-demultiplexed-seqs 1_import.qza --p-front AGRGTTYGATYMTGGCTCAG --p-adapter RGYTACCTTGTTACGACTT --p-min-len 1000 --p-max-len 1600 --p-n-threads 10 --o-table 2_table2.qza --o-representative-sequences 2_repseqs2.qza --o-denoising-stats 2_stats2.qza --o-base-transition-stats 2_bt_stats2.qza
# Approximately 3 hrs 40 mins
(q2_261)$ qiime metadata tabulate --m-input-file 2_stats2.qza --o-visualization 2_stats2.qzv
(q2_261)$ qiime feature-table summarize --i-table 2_table2.qza --o-feature-frequencies 2_feature_freqs2.qza --o-sample-frequencies 2_sample_freqs2.qza  --o-summary 2_table2.qzv --m-metadata-file ../metadata.tsv
(q2_261)$ qiime feature-table tabulate-seqs --i-data 2_repseqs2.qza --o-visualization 2_repseqs2.qzv

Remove primers and denoise

Trying BBDuk, instead of the default adapters.fa file, a new file, pacbio_primers.fa, with required primer sequences was used

primers_file = FileAttachment("./primers.fa").text()
html`<pre>${primers_file}</pre>`















BBDuk
(qc)$ bbduk.sh in=raw_reads/SRR23295634.fastq.gz out=bb_out/SRR23295634.fq.gz ref=~/pacbio_primers.fa copyundefined k=17 mink=7 hdist=1 hdist2=0 ktrim=rl
The same was run as script on all samples - run_bbduk_PacBio.py (not provided here)
utility_paths.csv was modified to look for pacbio_primers.fa (irrelevant; self note)
After processing with bbduk.sh no primer sequences were found (Table 6)

Using raw3 and filt2 for downstream analysis


Classification
Silva classifier may not give species level resolution. Since we have full length 16S rRNA reads, other classifiers like GreenGenes, GTDB, or NCBI may be useful. Most of the classiffiers are avaialble at QIIME2 resources page.
With NCBI classifier
# in q2_raw directory
(q2_261)$ qiime feature-classifier classify-sklearn --i-classifier ~/ncbi_refseqs_classifier_04032026.qza --i-reads 2_repseqs3.qza --o-classification 3_taxonomy_ncbi.qza --p-n-jobs 10
(q2_261)$ qiime metadata tabulate --m-input-file 3_taxonomy_ncbi.qza --o-visualization 3_taxonomy_ncbi.qzv
(q2_261)$ qiime taxa barplot --i-table 2_table3.qza --i-taxonomy 3_taxonomy_ncbi.qza --m-metadata-file ../metadata.tsv --o-visualization 3_taxa_plots_ncbi.qzv


Phylogeny
With mafft and iqtree
# in q2_raw
(q2_261)$ qiime phylogeny align-to-tree-mafft-iqtree --p-seed 380 --p-alrt 1000 --p-substitution-model 'GTR+G' --p-n-threads 10 --i-sequences 2_repseqs3.qza --o-alignment 4_aligned_repseqs.qza --o-masked-alignment 4_masked_rep_seqs.qza --o-tree 4_unrooted_tree.qza --o-rooted-tree 4_rooted_tree.qza


Rarefaction curves
# in q2_raw
(q2_261)$ qiime diversity alpha-rarefaction --i-table 2_table3.qza --i-phylogeny 4_rooted_tree.qza --p-max-depth 45000 --m-metadata-file ../metadata.tsv --o-visualization 5_alpha_rarefaction.qzv
The minimum feature count should be sufficient for rarefaction (Figure 1)








Figure 1: Alpha rarefaction curves (raw3)






Repeat these 3 steps (classification, phylogeny, and rarefaction curves) in the q2_filt directory







Cautionq2_filt





After classification and generation of taxa plots, it was observed that there were only 4 species identified across the samples. q2_filt method is not suitable for analysis.

title: PacBio 16S rRNA reads
text:
Using HiFi 16S workflow
The official package for 16S amplicon analysis

Installation
As on 04 Jul 2026, newest version of nextflow is not working with this workflow. Using an older version (24.10)
$ git clone https://github.com/PacificBiosciences/HiFi-16S-workflow.git
$ cd HiFi-16S-workflow/
$ mamba create -n pb_16s
(pb_16s)$ mamba install -c bioconda nextflow=24.10*
(pb_16s)$ nextflow run main.nf --download_db


Run
(pb_16s)$ nextflow run main.nf --input /run/media/anwesh/hdd_4tb/Files/Analyses/Microbiome/amplicon/test_pacbio/manifest_pb16s.tsv --metadata /run/media/anwesh/hdd_4tb/Files/Analyses/Microbiome/amplicon/test_pacbio/metadata.tsv --outdir /run/media/anwesh/hdd_4tb/Files/Analyses/Microbiome/amplicon/test_pacbio/pb_16s --dada2_cpu 10 --vsearch_cpu 10 --cutadapt_cpu 10 --publish_dir_mode copy
All steps, except the last html report generation, were successful.

Use --skip_primer_trim parameter to skip primer trimming
